titre_page: How do I explain my nodes with notes and frames? | Yop2D guide
description: In the Yop2D Blueprint, add sticky notes and frames to explain your script: title, text, color, and a "?" that opens the explanation.
h1: Explaining your nodes with notes and frames
carte: Write explanations right inside the Blueprint.
etapes: Tap the sticky-note button in the Blueprint, then write your text.
Tap the "?" on a frame to read its explanation.
blocs: A script of nodes quickly gets long. **Notes** work like comments: you write, for yourself or for people who open your game, **what** a group of nodes **is for**. They change nothing in the game. There are two kinds: the **Sticky note** (free, anywhere) and the **Frame** (which surrounds nodes).
In the Blueprint, tap the **sticky-note** button (a small folded square) in the top bar: a note appears.
Tap it to edit it: give it a **title** (optional), write your explanation, pick one of the 6 **colors**, then tap **OK**.
Drag it to move it. Pull the **corner handle** to make it bigger.
Tap the small **–** to fold it into an **i** icon. Tap the icon to open it again.
To delete a note, tap it then **Remove**.
Tap the **selection** button (the dotted square) in the top bar.
Pick the nodes: drag a rectangle in the empty space around them, or tap them one by one.
In the bottom bar, tap **Frame them**.
Tap the frame's title bar to give it a title and a color.
When you drag a frame's bar, **the nodes inside follow it**.

Every frame has a small **?** that opens a bubble with its explanation. In the bubble, **Edit** changes the text, **Remove** removes the frame (the nodes stay) and **Close** closes the bubble. Perfect for an example or a template that explains itself.
Notes are saved with the Blueprint (the 💾 button).
"Tidy up the nodes" does not move frames: tidy first, frame afterwards.
An older version of Yop2D that reopens and saves your project **loses the notes**: update Yop2D before sharing a project.
